svg.title: Tooth Fairy and Prospector
svg.text: Two sibling classifiers in Jarvis. Each sorts automatically detected events in 64-channel mouse hippocampal recordings into real spikes and garbage.
A moment Incisor or Doppler marked,
seen on the 32 even channels of a
Depth counts from its own peak channel;
how it spreads down the shank
voltage and CSD, step by step in time
how near the other candidates are
its sinks and sources across depth
brain rhythm then: delta, theta, gamma
which way it points above and below
voltage and CSD after aligning, ±14 ms
Five forests of boosted trees, each with its own seed.
Every branch picks from a random half of the numbers.
Their five scores are averaged into one.
Rare garbage is repeated in training, so both sides count equally.
lives in Checkup, step 2 of The Dentist
held out: each mouse scored by models that never saw it
share of real DS a person allows
Trained on 46 recordings, 26 mice and 14,205 candidates (2,155 of them garbage).
The 5th model; steps 1–4 led here. Run ai20261007-231323-671d.
lives in Panning, step 2 of The Confluence
held out: each recording scored with itself left out
where the Spike bar could sit
Chosen: the 0.99 bar. Fit on all data,
it is p ≥ 0.979: held out, 47% of spikes
A real sweep, KCNT1 m2 s2: 571 events in 129 s
Its own sibling: pooled events include P-spikes that the older data threw out.
Trained on 24,390 pooled events (15,849 spike, 8,541 garbage), 40 recordings, 22 mice.
Same 18 inputs plus origin: Incisor only 14,990 · both detectors 4,428 · Doppler only 4,972.
One recording held out at a time, 40 times: AUC 0.942. Run pr20261104-071200.
The AI pre-labels; a person decides.
Jarvis, Barry Lab. Score shapes are real held-out scores, each scaled to its own height: Tooth Fairy run ai20261007-231323-671d, Prospector run pr20261104-071200.
